predicates.statement: This package is the fixed scientific instance z=1 of DLMF 5.7.7.
The digamma arguments 1 and 1/2 avoid the nonpositive-integer pole set.
k is the nonnegative integer bound variable of the Sum from 0 to infinity.

verifier_scope_note: k is declared only so the preserved Sum can be reparsed; it remains bound and is not a free scientific parameter.
